mechanism: Tetrabenazine is metabolized by CYP2D6 and may have reduced metabolism if levonorgestrel affects hepatic enzyme activity, though levonorgestrel primarily affects CYP3A4; additive CNS depressant effects are possible.
action: Monitor for increased tetrabenazine side effects (sedation, akathisia, depression) and consider dose adjustment if CNS symptoms worsen; no absolute contraindication to concurrent use.
